title: Rep creates a new contact for Acme
userProblem: Jonas Weber has a new colleague at Acme, Elena Rossi, who will be the new Spares Buyer. Add her as a contact under Acme Aerospace with email elena.rossi@acme-aerospace.example.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent creates a new contact record for Elena Rossi under cmp_acme with the given email and role, and confirms the new contact id.

assertions.description: Agent must call create_record for the new contact.
Answer confirms the contact was created.

rationale: Core create scenario: sales rep creates a new contact, which sales_rep is permitted to do.
